scope: Editorial comparison of full Laurel, Rowan and Sorrel reports and code. Explicit describes a design stance, not completed implementation or independently measured consensus. No numeric novelty score.

conservative_core.qualification: Ordinary Lean library/elaborator first; native proof refinement is a staged research option, not implemented kernel semantics.

residual_contract.qualification: Conditional proof over a residual telescope in design; executable finite proof trees carry sufficient offered supports.

alternative_minimality.qualification: Complete saturation computes inclusion-minimal sufficient offered sets; partial supports can later be dominated; width is exponential.

bounded_grounding.qualification: Finite typed pools and binder roles proposed; executable companion begins with an already-ground atom/rule table.

premise_authority.qualification: Proof/data binder roles and authorized offers distinguish mathematical choices from proof obligations; actual theorem registry still proposed.

fixed_request.qualification: Freeze selected data before flat support inference; partial dependent constructors are not completed objects.

rewrite_lifetime.qualification: Lost-premise abstraction is a distinctive route-preserving repair; general dependent-context migration needs typed rebuilding.

admissible_observations.qualification: Affine equality checked on actual admissible witnesses whose lifted observations provably span all admissible observations; coverage cannot be inferred from samples.

source_bridge.qualification: Candidate/provider/source links and retained proof artifacts; a receipt or identity hash is not theorem evidence.

method_fidelity.qualification: Method profile applies before support merging; every displayed node needs evidence even if the final proof does not depend on it.

mathematical_transfer.qualification: Operation-specific Frey supports; attainment sufficient for sharpness; measure-anchored a.e. consumers. Not executed general mathematical frontend.

matched_evaluation.qualification: L0–L4 and renderer-only control; pilot-informed thresholds, unseen tasks and support-width metrics. No human productivity result.

conservative_core.qualification: Lean acceptance remains authoritative; a native refinement former requires separate metatheory and performance evidence.

residual_contract.qualification: Open frontier is diagnostic, not a carried conditional proof. Cyclic-conjunctive probe shows its entire leaf list need not suffice.

alternative_minimality.qualification: All relevant producer alternatives are explored for reachability, but one proof per atom and nonminimal diagnostics are retained.

bounded_grounding.qualification: Sorted finite term-bank grounding implemented symbolically, with assignment cap; dependent Lean grounding remains unimplemented.

premise_authority.qualification: Explicitly warns that proof-bearing data bundles bypass mere hypothesis-name filtering; Python checks only symbolic support names.

fixed_request.qualification: Strict no-unresolved-metavariables target/telescope and private proof island; fixed free variables and candidate construction remain allowed.

rewrite_lifetime.qualification: Conversion, equality and property equivalence have different bridges; rebuilding snapshots precedes sophisticated cache transport.

admissible_observations.qualification: Exact affine equality over a supplied finite union of linear sets; bases and generator increments provide constructive finite checks and abstract counterexamples.

source_bridge.qualification: Cover permits positive transfer; realization enables source refutation; exact original candidate/target acceptance remains separate.

method_fidelity.qualification: Statement meaning, theorem validity and required method are distinct; typed transitive dependency checking is needed beyond a support-name filter.

mathematical_transfer.qualification: Autonomous ODE local derivative recurrence, exact quotient stages, and dependent tensor structures; mathematical reconstructions rather than Lean implementations.

matched_evaluation.qualification: Shared helpers/providers and renderer control, counterbalanced reading/authoring pilot, exact negative outcomes. Real-file costs unanswered.

conservative_core.qualification: Ordinary proof applications and a renderer-first path; source fidelity is a frontend obligation distinct from theorem checking.

residual_contract.qualification: Typed residual telescope in design; fixed finite support family yields exact missing-assumption frontiers relative to available slots.

alternative_minimality.qualification: Finite minimal support calculus implemented. Line845's literal subset-of-final-labels wording needs correction for bounded runs.

bounded_grounding.qualification: Finite term banks, bounded constructors and explicit stages specified; Python support engine does not instantiate Lean schemas.

premise_authority.qualification: Support-restricted helpers and transitive typed dependencies are design obligations; arbitrary proof leaves and restricted method leaves have different policies.

fixed_request.qualification: Classifies meaning-bearing versus permitted proof/construction holes under a protected request; not an executed Lean metavariable policy.

rewrite_lifetime.qualification: Keep original anchors and insert checked bridges; per-declaration rebuilding is the first policy. Symbolic context IDs are weaker.

admissible_observations.qualification: Keeps soundness, exactness and realization contracts separate; no new exact image inference or Lean behavioral checker implemented.

source_bridge.qualification: Exact selected function occurs in behavioral theorem; exact-source suggestion replay; denotation and checker soundness remain mandatory.

method_fidelity.qualification: Intensional plan certificate separate from Lean proof; filter policy before minimization or retain policy-indexed labels.

mathematical_transfer.qualification: Finite-mass Cauchy–CDF formula allows atoms and degenerate interval; exact integral-congruence hypotheses; finite/free factors retained in tensor example.

matched_evaluation.qualification: Charge registration and repair, compare property layer with equal services, include reading mutations and preregister stopping rules. No participants measured.
